reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.comment: I was worried about the quality at first because of the price and also not being familiar with the brand. But since I've installed them, I can attest to how incredible these fans are all around. My only con would be that they can get a little loud when they're approaching max speed, but I do have 10 of them in my rig so that probably amps up the sound a bit. I have a complete studio setup with sound engineering quality speakers though, so I literally never hear them. They're not even that loud to begin with though. Other than, they look and feel great and I'd definitely recommend! Oh and being able to choose which direction the fans blow so that none of them look backwards is what really sold me.
reviews.author: Justin Doan
